request:

Exact content:

Quantity: 12
Price: 250

File: supplier.txt
Exact content:
Supplier: Nile Tech
City: Cairo
Status: Active

File: shipment.txt
Exact content:
Shipment: SH-2026
Items: 12

Do not create any other files.

Verify that all three files exist and independently confirm their exact contents before reporting the task as complete.
